magicLink.subject: Your Altera login link
magicLink.body:
Hello,

you requested a login link for Altera. Click the button below — it is valid for 15 minutes and can only be used once.

If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

someone just signed into your Altera account. If this was you — all is well.

meta.title: Plans and pricing — Altera
meta.description: Reading is free for everyone. At the first launch you can write and publish without paying; paid plans arrive later.

hero.title: A subscription is the path to authorship
hero.lede: Reading is free for everyone. A plan decides what you can create and publish.
hero.launchNote: There is no billing at the first launch: this page shows no prices and no payment buttons. Basic authoring opens by itself the first time you press «Create article» — without payment and without manual approval. Paid plans arrive later.

whyAccount.question: Why do I need an account if reading is free?
whyAccount.answer: An account is for bookmarks, following authors, and your own articles. Published material can be read without one.

howToWrite.question: How do I start writing at the first launch?
howToWrite.answer: Press «Create article»: basic authoring opens without payment and without manual approval.

prices.question: Why are there no prices on this page?
prices.answer: The first launch is free. The plans are shown so the future paid tiers are visible; prices arrive together with billing.

myArticles.question: What happens to my articles once paid plans arrive?
myArticles.answer: Published articles stay published, and your own articles, rating, and personal analytics stay readable.

moderation.question: How does review work?
moderation.answer: The review procedure is described in the publication rules and does not depend on the plan.

refunds.question: Can I get my money back?
refunds.answer: There are no payments at the first launch, so there is nothing to refund. The refund procedure is described separately and starts working together with billing.
